purpose: Test whether restoring the frozen FaaSRank deterministic epsilon-greedy decision stream removes V72's throughput loss, and whether either of two outcome-blind NSESche Pareto guards can improve throughput and both QPR definitions on untouched same-seed tapes.

source.V72_aggregate_finding: The frozen V71 exploit-only anchor failed the strict throughput gate by -0.690077 percent while passing both QPR mean gates. This aggregate finding motivates restoring the already-frozen epsilon path; no V72 per-seed subgroup is used for V73 design or selection.

mechanism_hypothesis.frozen_difference_from_V71: The initializer uses the existing faasrank_ready_faithful deterministic epsilon=0.1 selector instead of exploitation-only faasrank_operational_penalty. Scores, weights, candidate frontier, native request/DAG order, 256-decision history, common HPA and paper utility are unchanged.

profiles.post_initialization_rule: A move requires strict paper-utility improvement and strict frozen FaaSRank exploitation-score improvement.
A move requires strict paper-utility improvement, strict completion-proxy improvement and nonworse frozen FaaSRank exploitation score.

result_blind_execution_order: Commit and push this plan before generating any E420-E429 run spec, tape or output.
Generate four ten-run manifests from one source: FaaSRank, faithful anchor control, faithful score Pareto and faithful completion Pareto.
Capture ten base tapes once, derive ten scale5 tapes and bind identical per-seed hashes to all four profiles.
Bind the frozen FaaSRank model only to the comparator manifest and build all thirty NSESche references before online execution.
Run FaaSRank first, then faithful anchor, score Pareto and completion Pareto, strictly serially without reading intermediate performance.
Require forty attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact four-way pairing and one runtime identity before opening summaries exactly once.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across ten paired seeds.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run throughput/(latency*cost) across finite paired runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same QPR with zero-completion runs contributing zero over all ten seeds.
analysis.fidelity_gate: For every seed, the faithful anchor and FaaSRank must have exactly equal completed-request count and bitwise-equal finite scientific summary values for fixed-window throughput, mean latency, cost, finite-only QPR state and zero-as-zero QPR. Any mismatch fails the screen and prevents candidate interpretation.
analysis.candidate_gate: After the fidelity gate passes, a selection candidate mean must strictly exceed the same-seed FaaSRank mean for throughput, finite-only QPR and zero-as-zero QPR; ties fail.
analysis.selection_rule: If both candidates pass all three strict mean gates, select the candidate with the larger minimum relative improvement across the three metrics; an exact tie fails and selects neither. The fidelity control is never selection eligible.
analysis.paired_uncertainty: Report paired candidate-minus-FaaSRank differences and BCa 95% confidence intervals without changing either gate.
analysis.success_action: Freeze the selected profile and preregister a separate twenty-seed confirmation beginning at E430 before operational closure.
analysis.failure_action: Retain the complete V73 cohort. Do not promote the control, relax a gate, switch using a subgroup, or reuse E420-E429 for further tuning; any next mechanism starts after E429.
